consent_what_body.message: Unfret checks product pages for scam shops, generic factory goods sold as a brand, fake discounts and pushy tricks such as fake countdowns, and explains what it found in plain words.

consent_sent_body.message: Only when you click “Check this page”: the product facts and the cleaned visible text of that page go to unfret.kroshtan.com. Never your account details or anything you typed. Page addresses aren't stored, nothing is sold and there are no affiliate links. Product prices are kept anonymously for 90 days to spot fake discounts.

consent_pay_body.message: Sign in with a Solana wallet, or use an API key, and use prepaid checks. A new wallet may get a few free checks to try it.

opt_api_base.description: Label of the API base field.

opt_server_help.message: The default is $1. For development, http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 (any port) can be used; the browser asks you to allow access to it. Testing against the dev deployment is done with the separate Unfret Dev extension.
opt_server_help.description: Options help text. $1 is the default API base.

opt_only_https.message: Only the default, or a local server on http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1, can be used.

opt_denied.message: Access to that address was not allowed; keeping the previous server.

opt_privacy_body.message: Unfret reads a page only when you click "Check this page". It then sends the product facts and the page's visible product text (without account menus, addresses or forms) to the Unfret server. It stores only your sign-in session or API key, your consent and these settings in your browser, and no analysis history. A page is shared for review only when you report a result as wrong and agree.

opt_using_key.description: Options account status; $1 is the key's public ID.

opt_key_help.message: An API key is an alternative to a wallet: buy checks for it with SOL, USDC (or later a card) on the checkout page and paste it here. It is kept only in this browser.
